name: Subtitle 4
text: ClearCorrect business case
textPreview: ClearCorrect business case

name: Subtitle 4
text: Head of Growth discussion
textPreview: Head of Growth discussion

text:
Open with the role objective: translating global strategy into practical programs that grow practices, patient demand, and case volume.
Position the case as a commercial growth operating model, not a creative campaign proposal.

name: Google Shape;533;p58
text: The opportunity is to turn strong assets into measurable practice-level growth.
textPreview: The opportunity is to turn strong assets into measurable practice-level growth.

name: Content Placeholder 9
text:
What ClearCorrect already has
Provider marketing resources, digital workflow tools, clinical education, and Straumann Group credibility.
textPreview: What ClearCorrect already has | Provider marketing resources, digital workflow tools, clinical education, and Straumann Group credibility.

name: Content Placeholder 10
text:
What the program adds
A repeatable full-funnel system: diagnose, activate, convert, enable, measure, and scale.
textPreview: What the program adds | A repeatable full-funnel system: diagnose, activate, convert, enable, measure, and scale.

text:
Reference the official ClearCorrect marketing resources and doctor ecosystem as existing strengths.
The strategic point: the business case does not ask ClearCorrect to start from zero; it organizes and scales what already exists.

name: Google Shape;534;p58
text:
Where growth leaks today
Patient interest may exist, but practices can lose momentum through slow follow-up, weak consult flow, low staff confidence, or limited provider utilization.
textPreview: Where growth leaks today | Patient interest may exist, but practices can lose momentum through slow follow-up, weak consult flow, low sta...

name: Content Placeholder 1
text:
What good looks like
A connected practice funnel: demand generation, lead nurturing, consultation conversion, case start, repeat utilization, and referral.
textPreview: What good looks like | A connected practice funnel: demand generation, lead nurturing, consultation conversion, case start, repeat utiliz...

name: Google Shape;533;p58
text: The business problem
textPreview: The business problem

text:
Explain that demand alone is not enough. If the practice cannot follow up and convert, marketing spend does not become case growth.
This slide shows commercial judgment: solve the full funnel, not one isolated campaign step.

text: Three growth levers
textPreview: Three growth levers

name: Content Placeholder 10

name: Content Placeholder 10
text:
3. Provider utilization
Segmentation, case confidence, CE support, sales coaching, and repeat-use tracking.
textPreview: 3. Provider utilization | Segmentation, case confidence, CE support, sales coaching, and repeat-use tracking.

text:
Use this slide to show the logic of the program: patient marketing, sales enablement, and clinical education have to operate together.
Make clear that each lever has a behavior change attached to it.

Emphasize global core and local flex: the program has standard logic, but markets adapt language, channels, and legal requirements.

text:
Weeks 0-2: baseline
Select 45-60 practices across 3 markets, capture case history, diagnose funnel gaps, and align sales plus CE owners.

Mention that control groups or matched non-participating practices help avoid overclaiming impact.

name: Content Placeholder 1
text:
Measure four layers
Adoption: practices enrolled, diagnostics completed, toolkit usage.
Demand: leads, consults booked, event registrations.
Conversion: lead-to-consult, attendance, consult-to-start.
Business: incremental cases, active provider utilization, ROI proxy.
textPreview: Measure four layers | Adoption: practices enrolled, diagnostics completed, toolkit usage. | Demand: leads, consults booked, event registr...

text:
Frame KPI targets as assumptions to validate, not promises.
Use formula-based ROI: incremental cases x net revenue per case minus program cost, divided by program cost.
